conn.title: Connect to daemon
conn.error: Could not reach the daemon. Check the address and token.
dashboard.title: Creative tools
dashboard.subtitle: Everything runs locally on your machine.
library.title: File library
library.col.name: Name
settings.title: Settings
settings.models.ncConfirm: This model has a non-commercial license. Personal/non-commercial use only. Continue?
sub.title: Subtitles & Translation
sub.subtitle: Transcribe speech, proofread, translate into many languages, export and burn into video.
sub.noSource: No source yet. Upload a file or paste a link.
sub.glossaryHint:
Robusta = Robusta
Tây Nguyên = Central Highlands
sub.llmDown: Cannot reach the local LLM. Start Ollama.
sub.llmModel: Ollama does not have the model {model}.
sub.stale: The source changed after this translation — consider re-translating.
sub.fallbacks: {n} lines could not be translated and keep the source text.
tts.title: Voice-over
tts.subtitle: Turn a script into speech: multiple speakers, pauses, speed, consent-based voice cloning.
tts.syntax: Use [Name] at the start of a line to switch speaker and [pause 1.5s] for a pause. VieNeu emotion tags such as [cười] are kept as-is.
tts.noSpeakers: Write a script to see its speakers.
tts.needModel: A voice model must be downloaded:
tts.cloneHelp: Upload a 10–30 second voice sample (3 s minimum; only the first 8 s are used). You may only clone your own voice or the voice of someone who has agreed. Never use it to impersonate or deceive.
tts.subject: Name of the voice owner
tts.consent: I confirm that I have the right to use this voice and that the person agreed to an AI copy of their voice being made.
dub.title: Video dubbing
dub.subtitle: Translated subtitles → re-voiced in a new voice, timing-matched, background kept, muxed into the video.
dub.needSource: No source yet. Create subtitles and a translation in Subtitles & Translation first.
dub.needTrack: No translation yet. Translate the subtitles into the dubbing language.
dub.stats: {ok} fit · {sped} sped up · {long} still long · {short} shortened
hl.title: Summary & Highlights
hl.subtitle: Find the best moments in a long video, export vertical 9:16 clips with subtitles, or build a narrated summary video.
hl.needTranscript: No transcript yet. Run speech recognition in Subtitles & Translation first.
hl.analysis: {w} candidate windows · {s} scored by LLM · {sc} scene changes
hl.summaryHelp: Joins the selected clips; each gets one LLM-written sentence read by an AI voice, original audio is turned down. A narration longer than its clip holds the last frame.
pod.title: Podcast
pod.subtitle: From a topic or document → 2–3 host dialogue script → voices, intro/outro music, a bed that ducks under speech → MP3 with chapters, waveform video, show notes.
pod.noScript: No script yet: let the LLM write it, or edit it yourself once created.
pod.speaker: Speaker
pod.musicHelp: Built-in music is generated by OpenStudio (simple, royalty-free). You can add your own but must state its license/source.
ag.title: AI assistant
ag.subtitle: Give commands in plain language; the assistant calls the very tools you use on the other pages and asks you to approve heavy steps.
ag.empty: For example: "Create Vietnamese subtitles for this video and translate them to English" or "Cut 3 TikTok clips from the video".
ag.autoHelp: Only applies to media export/mix steps. Model downloads and external (MCP) tools always ask you.
ag.question: More information needed:
ag.approval.title: Your approval is needed: {tool}
sk.title: Skills & Schedules
sk.subtitle: A skill is plain-text guidance (it runs no code) for the assistant: when to use it, the steps, the acceptance criteria.
sk.pick: Pick a skill to read it.
sk.safety: An imported skill is only suggestion text for the assistant; every step is still parameter-checked and goes through the approval gate. Read it carefully anyway.
sk.scheduleHelp: When due, the assistant opens a new conversation and runs the request. Steps that need approval wait for you there.
sk.scheduleMessage: Request to send to the assistant
camp.title: Content campaign
camp.subtitle: Goal + markets + platforms → a 7/14/30-day plan, posting schedule in each market's time zone, localized captions/hashtags/thumbnails → export package + schedule.csv.
camp.fxHelp: Enter your own exchange rate so posts in that market mention a price; without a rate, NO price is mentioned.
camp.reviewNote: Content is written by a local AI — have a native speaker review prices, terminology and advertising rules before posting.
camp.caption: Caption
asset.title: Project assets
asset.empty: No assets yet. Upload a video, image or audio file.
ed.title: Video editor
ed.subtitle: Cut, join, add text and images, music that ducks under speech, transitions, speed changes — FFmpeg-based with a quick preview.
ed.empty: The timeline is empty — add videos/images from the asset library.
th.title: Thumbnails & covers
th.subtitle: Combine an image or video frame with a fully accented title, several layouts and palettes. (No AI image generation — that needs a GPU.)
th.aiNote: AI image generation (FLUX…) needs a GPU with ≥ 12 GB and is not integrated yet.
av.title: AI avatar
av.subtitle: Portrait + voice → talking avatar video with background/frame/subtitles, landscape or vertical.
av.name: Avatar name
av.isReal: Is this image of a real person?
av.subject: Full name of the person shown
av.consentStatement: I have the rights and consent of this person
av.noCeleb: Do not use images of celebrities or of people who have not consented. The confirmation record is stored locally.
av.mouthHelp: Fractions 0–1 of the image (x horizontal, y vertical, w width); adjust to the character's mouth.
img.title: AI image generation
img.subtitle: Describe in Vietnamese or English → FLUX.2 klein 4B generates the image on your machine (CPU, slow). Images are added to the asset library for Thumbnail, Video editor and Avatar.
img.needModels: Download the image engine and model first (one time, Apache-2.0, SHA-256 verified).
img.translate: Translate the prompt to English with the local LLM
img.estimate: Estimated ~{min} min on CPU (measured: a 512 px image ≈ 4 min; larger is much slower).
img.refHelp: Used to edit/transform an existing image according to the description.
img.aiLabel: AI-generated images; a .png.json file beside each image records the AI label. Do not ask the AI to draw Vietnamese text — add it with the Thumbnail tool.
vid.title: Video
vid.subtitle: Turn an image (including an AI image you just made) into a moving video with zoom/pan. This is NOT AI video generation — that needs a large GPU.
vid.notAi: Camera motion over a still image, not AI-generated video.
